run_aggregate_low_shot_svm_stats: run the script to aggregate low-shot SVM test AP stats across samples and k-values
run_aggregate_stats: run aggregate_stats to compute mean, max, min, std over SVM sample result files
run_save_stats: run save_stats to write a numpy array of aggregated stats to a .npy file
review_aggregate_stats: review aggregate_stats to understand how it loads per-sample .npy files and computes statistics
refactor_aggregate_stats: refactor aggregate_stats to support additional statistical measures beyond mean, max, min, and std
